name: Altshuler Shaham Finance Ltd
summary: The company specializes in the administration of various provident and pension funds. Its extensive portfolio includes savings provident funds, general provident funds, personal and central severance pay provident funds, study funds, and central sick pay provident funds. Furthermore, it manages investment provident funds, which encompass specialized children's savings plans, alongside both comprehensive and general pension schemes. Beyond these, the firm also oversees alternative real estate investment portfolios. The company's operations are headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
